name: Steel Ingot
description: Creates a Steel Ingot

name: Brimsteel Ingot
description: Creates a Brimsteel Ingot

name: Mechanical Parts
description: Creates 3x Mechnical Parts

name: Iron Pipes
description: Creates 2x Iron Pipes

name: Bundle of Wire
description: Creates 1 Bundle of Copper Wire

name: Reinforced Leather Armor
description: Creates Leather Armor with metal reinforcements using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots and Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3.
ingredients: 2 Heavy Leather Bundles, 2 Vials of Mercury, 3 Ingots

name: Medium Armor
description: Creates Medium Armor using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 3 and Starsteel 5.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Creates Heavy Armor using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 2 Infusions, Aetherium 4 and Starsteel 6.

name: Ultra-Heavy Armor
description: Creates Ultra-Heavy Armor using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 3 Infusions, Aetherium 5 and Starsteel 7.

name: Medium Armored Saddle
description: Creates an armored saddle using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 3 and Starsteel 5.
ingredients: 1 Heavy Leather Bundles, 2 Light Leather Bundles, 4 Mechanical Parts, 1 Ingots

name: Large Armored Saddle
description: Creates an armored saddle using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 3 and Starsteel 5.
ingredients: 2 Heavy Leather Bundles, 4 Light Leather Bundles, 4 Mechanical Parts, 2 Ingots

name: Huge Armored Saddle
description: Creates an armored saddle using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 3 and Starsteel 5.
ingredients: 10 Heavy Leather Bundles, 8 Light Leather Bundles, 4 Mechanical Parts, 6 Ingots

name: Reinforced Leather Gloves / Boots / Helmet
description: Creates Reinforced Leather Gloves, Helmet or Boots using either an Iron, Steel Aetherium or Starsteel Ingot and Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3.

name: Armored Gloves / Boots / Helmet
description: Creates Armored Gauntlets, Helmet or Boots using either Iron, Steel Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3.

name: Light Shield
description: Creates a Light Shield using either an Iron, Steel Aetherium or Starsteel Ingot. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3.

name: Heavy Shield
description: Creates a Light Shield using either an Iron, Steel Aetherium or Starsteel Ingot. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3

name: Craft Light 1-Handed Melee Weapon
description: Creates a Light 1-Handed Melee Weapon using either an Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingot and a Strip of Heavy Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3.

name: Craft Light 2-Handed/Heavy 1 Handed Melee Weapon
description: Creates a Light 2-Handed or Heavy 1-Handed Melee Weapon using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots and a Strip of Heavy Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 3 and Starsteel 4.

name: Craft Heavy 2-Handed Melee Weapon
description: Creates a Light 2-Handed or Heavy 1-Handed Melee Weapon using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots and a Strip of Heavy Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 2 Infusions, Aetherium 4 and Starsteel 6.

name: Craft Accessory
overcraft: You create a duplicate of the Crafted Object
description: Craft an accessory such as a ring, necklace, or bracer using an Ingot. The quality of Metal used determines the number of Infusions that can be placed on it with Gold allowing 1 and Platinum 2.

name: Catalyst Slotting Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Melee Weapon, Gloves or Boots with a slot to place a Catalyst Gem which deals bonus Damage based on the catalyst when making Melee or Unarmed Attacks with the piece of equipment

name: Conduit Slot Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Object with a Conduit Slot, allowing you to place a Core inside.

name: Balancing Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Melee Weapon with +1 Attack by reinforcing the metal with cobalt. This infusion can be used on Gloves or Boots to grant +1 Unarmed Attack when making unarmed attacks with that piece of equipment. Only one Infusion of this type can be used on an Object.

name: Toughened Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Chest Armor or Shield with +1 Block. Only one Infusion of this type can be used on an Object.

name: Reinforced Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Boots, Gloves, Helmet, Shield or Chest Armor with +1 Physical Mitigation.

name: Flexible Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Chest Armor with +1 Dodge. Only one Infusion of this type can be used on an Object.

name: Insulating Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Boots, Gloves, Helmet, Shield or Chest Armor with +1 Elemental Mitigation.

name: Silver Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Weapon or Chest Armor with the Silvered Property and adding +2 Dark Mitigation

name: Blackened Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Weapon or Chest Armor with the Blackened Property and adding +2 Divine Mitgiation.

name: Immutable Infusion
description: Infuse a piece of equipment with Lead, making it Immutable and adding +2 Arcane Mitigation.

name: Ignitable Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Weapon, Gloves or Boots with Brimsteel. When this piece of equipment or its wielder is the target of Fire Damage or is intentionally ignited, it burns for 1 Minute giving off 3 Units of light. In the event of a True Hit while using this piece of equipment as a weapon, the target of the attack gains the Ignited condition.

name: Nickel Alloy Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Weapon or Armor and make it easier to work with, lowering the Total Required Check by 1d6.

name: Armored Plating Augmentation [Bones/Scales]
description: Use Bones or Scales to enhance unfinished Chest equipment.  Requires Smithing Augmentations

name: Shield Plating Augmentation [Bones/Scales]
description: Use Bones or Scales to enhance unfinished Chest equipment. Requires Smithing Augmentations
ingredients: T1 Plating : +1 Physical and Elemental Mitigation
T2 Plating : +2 Physical and Elemental Mitigation and +1 Block
T3 Plating : +4 Physical and Elemental Mitigation and +2 Block

name: Leather Reinforcement Augmentation [Hide]
description: Use Hide to enhance unfinished Chest Armor. Requires Smithing Augmentations

name: Exotic Weapon Augmentation [Creature Part]
description: Use a part of a Creature in the creation of a Weapon such as a tooth, horn, antler or other part that could serve as a weapon. Requires Smithing Augmentations
